method.notes: Cleaning: MODIS confidence >= 30, VIIRS confidence in ['h', 'n'], day/night kept: ['D', 'N']. Factor = sum(target)/sum(source) over overlap months. Validation holds out the last 2 full overlap years (monthly MAPE skips months with < 10 target hotspots); headline error = leave-one-year-out, count-weighted. Unstable provincial links use the parent area's factor. Anomaly = vs median of the same month in earlier complete years. Areas follow real borders (Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1); Northern Australia is Australian land north of 20°S, 121-146°E. Counts are hotspots, not burned area. season.method: Monthly medians over complete years; fire season = the shortest run of consecutive months holding at least 80% of a typical year; peak = the 3 consecutive months with the highest medians.

early_warning.method: Hindcast: lead = the 2 months before the 3-month peak; each window is compared with the median of the same window in earlier complete years (at least 5); above normal = at least +15%. Spearman rank correlation with a one-sided permutation test (10000 shuffles, seed 0). A historical pattern, not a forecast.
